about.title: What a year in Rochester Hills leaves on a car.
body: Rochester Hills was Avon Township until 1984, and the hills in the name are real: the ground climbs from the southeast corner of the city to the northwest. M-59 crosses it as a freeway, and Rochester Road runs north from there toward downtown Rochester. Five things about the place show up on a vehicle, or decide how we get to it.

points.title: Salt on your own street
points.body: The city plows and salts its 241 miles of local roads as well as its major ones. So the salt does not stop at the subdivision entrance. It rides home on the rocker panels, dries white in the carpet and stays there until it is extracted, not just vacuumed.

points.title: Road spray on M-59
points.body: M-59 is a state highway that the county road commission maintains. Its crews salt during storms and spray liquid brine ahead of them. At freeway speed the wet road comes back up as a mist that dries on the paint, the wheels and the glass.

points.title: Trees the city protects
points.body: Rochester Hills requires a permit to take down a street tree and keeps a forestry unit to look after them. Park under one and the paint collects sap, leaves and bird droppings. Getting sap and tar off properly is the decontamination step in our Wash & Seal.

points.title: Trails, fields and dogs
points.body: The Paint Creek Trail has a fine limestone surface, the Clinton River Trail runs 4.5 miles through the city, and Borden Park is soccer fields and ball diamonds. Bikes, cleats and leashed dogs carry all of it back into the cargo area.

points.title: Driveways that suit a mobile detail
points.body: Single family homes are the largest land use in the city, and a driveway with room to walk the full perimeter of the vehicle is all we need. In a condo or apartment lot, tell us about the parking and we will say straight whether it works.

logistics.title: About 30 minutes to the shop. Or skip the drive.
body: From Rochester Hills you are heading across the county line to 33115 Louise Ave in Clinton Township, on the north side of 14 Mile Road, just east of Kelly Road. It is about 19 miles from central Rochester Hills, roughly 30 minutes without traffic. We are appointment only, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

Interior, exterior and full details can be done at your home or workplace in Rochester Hills, and we bring our own power and water. Coatings, tint and paint correction need the shop, where we control the light and the dust. If the trip is the problem, valet pickup collects the vehicle from you and returns it when the work is done. On ceramic coating jobs, Uber is covered if you drop it off yourself.

faq.q: Do you come to Rochester Hills for mobile detailing?
faq.a: Yes. Mobile and valet reach about 30 to 40 minutes from our shop, and Rochester Hills is inside that. We bring our own power and water, so you do not run a hose or a cord. All we ask for is a driveway or parking spot with room to walk around the whole vehicle. See [how mobile and valet work](/mobile-detailing/).

faq.q: How far is your shop from Rochester Hills?
faq.a: About 19 miles from central Rochester Hills, roughly 30 minutes without traffic. You are looking for 33115 Louise Ave in Clinton Township, over in Macomb County, on the north side of 14 Mile Road just east of Kelly Road. We are appointment only, so book before you head over. If half an hour each way does not fit your day, ask about valet pickup.

faq.q: Can you ceramic coat or tint my vehicle in my driveway?
faq.a: No. A coating and window film both need a closed, controlled space: no wind, no dust, steady light. That work is done at the shop, and so is paint correction. Valet pickup gets the vehicle there and back without you. For [ceramic coating](/ceramic-coating-rochester-hills-mi/) we also cover your Uber if you bring it in yourself. [Window tint](/window-tint-rochester-hills-mi/) is usually finished the day you drop off.

faq.q: What should I book after a winter on salted streets?
faq.a: For the inside, an Executive Interior Detail. Steam and hot water extraction lift what is in the carpet and mats, where a vacuum only takes the loose layer. It is from $239.99 for a coupe or sedan in average condition. For the outside, a Wash & Seal is a full decontamination wash with a 6 month ceramic sealant, from $139.99. SUVs and trucks are quoted for their size. See [detailing in Rochester Hills](/car-detailing-rochester-hills-mi/).
